reuse_rule: Match publisher/table/query/period/boundary identity, verify retained bytes and source eligibility, and resolve revisions before reuse. If inventory is incomplete, return inventory_incomplete, not capture. A complete negative inventory permits only an acquisition-admission decision, not automatic fetching.
rights_rule: Public accessibility or a catalogue entry does not itself establish redistribution rights. Preserve release-specific terms and source receipts. No restricted IDI or individual voter/patient data.
